task.quality_eligibility: All available matched learning trajectories must reach the published target. Retain failed trajectories and withhold completed-task means and labels for their configurations.
task.calibration: Frozen quantiles of the configuration means satisfying the quality condition, separately from BERT/SQuAD.
task.budget: Same multipliers of the task-specific median reference mean GPU energy.
task.recovery: Same declared surrogate overheads as BERT; sensitivity assumptions, not measured ShuffleNet checkpoint costs.
